| `scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` | none | **defeated** — the dispatch combines two callees' statuses with `\|\|`, so an early return in the first yields `undefined`, falls through to the second, and exits 0 | #13474 |
| `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` | none | **NOT MEASURED** — four self-test callees combined; a one-function probe measures a sub-battery and reads the downstream crash as a handshake | #13482 |

## One note worth keeping

`scripts/check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs` is the sibling #13489 names as having landed the named-set form — and it did, for its `SHAPES` / `samples` pair. That is a different property from its own self-test's floor. Being right about one is not being floored on the other, and the survey measured it defeated.

The last two files are Tier C for hole 2 (multi-entry: one handshake per callee, or a wrapper — a decision, not a transplant); `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` needs a hand-read entry before it can be measured at all.
